[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Expose SunMint trees/plots/farms + MAP media in the LLM discovery surface (beta→prod)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_me_beta/pull/368
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_me_beta/pull/370
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/981
  
  Details:
  Made the SunMint impact layer + Media Archives Pipeline (MAP) first-class, LLM-discoverable surfaces on truesight.me.
  
  Delivered:
  1. scripts/build_stats_current.py — new summarize_sunmint() + write_sunmint_index() → stats/sunmint_index.json (trees/plots/farms + north_star progress vs 10,000 ha + per-farm MAP media rollup). Reads public raw.githubusercontent URLs only, no credentials.
  2. .github/workflows/stats-refresh.yml — root-cause fix: the commit step staged only stats/current.json, so repos/programs/partners/beerhall indexes were stale since 2026-05-18. Now stages the whole stats/ dir (git add stats/), structurally eliminating the drift class.
  3. llms.txt — SunMint + MAP source block (5 URLs) + 3 Q→fetch routing rules with exact field names.
  4. agentic_ai_context LLM_DISCOVERY_SURFACE.md — registry row for stats/sunmint_index.json + provenance.
  
  Verification (live):
  - https://truesight.me/stats/sunmint_index.json → HTTP 200 (was 404); reads 100 trees, 22 plots / 273.43 ha, 15 farms, north_star 2.73%.
  - prod llms.txt byte-identical to beta (sha1 973c42f5); CNAME intact = truesight.me.
  - 21:07Z cron on prod committed all five indexes at one timestamp (staleness bug dead).
  
  Note: prod fork-sync initially returned conflict (sunmint.html + stats/current.json, plus governor-authorized prod-only reconciles); per policy I stopped and did not force. Governor resolved the sync.
  
  PRs:
  - truesight_me_beta #368 (builder + workflow + llms.txt)
  - truesight_me_beta #370 (workflow root-cause fix: stage whole stats/ dir)
  - agentic_ai_context #981 (LLM_DISCOVERY_SURFACE.md registry row)
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
